OncoCohortSelect: selection between single-arm oncology cohorts

Source: R/OncoCohortSelect-package.R
OncoCohortSelect-package.Rd

Selects one of several single-arm cohorts with multiple efficacy and safety endpoints for further development, by a posterior benefit-risk score and by generalized pairwise comparisons, and evaluates the selection rules by simulation.

  • Endpoint defines binary and time-to-event endpoints.

  • PosteriorProb computes the posterior probability of a favorable value of one endpoint, for one cohort or relative to a reference cohort.

  • BenefitRisk combines the posterior probabilities into a benefit-risk score with admissibility criteria.

  • WinStat computes the net treatment benefit, the win ratio and the win odds of prioritized endpoints.

  • SimCohorts, SimSelection, SelectionOC and CalibrateThreshold simulate cohorts and evaluate the selection rules.
